A food item which restores between {{Energy||20 -}} {{Energy||36}} and applies the circumspect buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, a fancy lentil soup will apply the circumspect buff for a duration of 2 minutes, which will give additional {{Techpoint|Blue}} when studying new items at the [[study table]] . For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
